name: ChatGPT
description: Ask ChatGPT a question from Ulauncher

preferences.name: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Optional. If set, answers are fetched directly from the OpenAI API and shown in Ulauncher. If left empty, Enter opens chatgpt.com with your prompt instead. Get a key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

preferences.name: OpenAI Model
preferences.description: Model to use when an OpenAI API key is set (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o)
